headline: Data-center demand drives record backlog and strong orders
summary_short: Sales rose 10% to $7.1B with organic growth of 12%, GAAP EPS was $1.60 and adjusted EPS $1.66. Orders grew 44% organically and backlog reached a record $23.0B.
summary_long: Americas sales grew 14% with adjusted segment EBITA margin up 210bp to 22.0%, driven by data-center demand; Americas orders rose 58% organically. EMEA organic sales grew 3% and APAC 13%. Cash from operations was $1.3B. Fiscal 2027 first-quarter guidance: organic sales growth of 12%-14% and adjusted EPS of $1.15-$1.20. Full-year fiscal 2027: organic sales growth of 11%-12% and operating leverage of 30%+.
confidence_notes: Period label follows the shard (FY2026 Q3, calendar-based); JCI's fiscal year ends in September, so this release covers JCI's fiscal Q4 and full fiscal 2026. Prior-year EPS was not in the portion of the release read, so no EPS delta is shown. Adjusted measures are non-GAAP.

drivers.explanation: Organic growth of 12%, led by Americas (+14%) on strength in Applied HVAC & Controls and data-center demand; EMEA sales declined 2% reported with pressure from Middle East conflicts.
Sustained data-center demand and differentiated technology; Americas backlog of $17.8B rose 54% organically.
CEO cites margin expansion across all three segments from productivity and simplification improvements, and enters fiscal 2027 with confidence on record backlog.
